failures: Implemented opportunity without an artifact was not diagnosed as malformed.
Implicit empty edit was not diagnosed instead of being treated as no-change.
Contradictory noChanges and implementation claims were not preserved as a candidate diagnostic.
Prompt did not separate quality objective from confidence semantics.
Prompt did not preserve the bounded passing-localization opportunity.
Prompt did not require compact opportunity takeover and residual-duty records.
Prompt did not distinguish candidate attempt from recommendation.

implementation.candidateRecommendationBoundary: The optimizer prompt and workspace README distinguish the workspace candidate attempt from a recommendation that survives executable checks and residual duties.
implementation.opportunityContract: Opportunity summaries retain delegated steps, variable parameters, required resources, check source, disposition reason and residual duty. Passing evidence may support bounded mechanical opportunities, including locale key/placeholder parity, without claiming translation-quality automation.
implementation.submissionDiagnostics: Normalization and post-diff reconciliation preserve malformed declarations in the actionDiagnostics channel. invalid-submission covers implicit empty or contradictory forms; implemented-opportunity-without-artifact covers false implementation claims. Legitimate no-change remains available only when the opportunity audit is consistent.
implementation.schemaCompatibility: The existing OptimizationActionDiagnostic channel and package/history schemas were extended with the two submission diagnostic codes; existing action diagnostics remain backward readable.

historicalMethodRegression.finding: The archived passing I18n no-change retained all opportunities because it treated no defect, whole-skill coverage limits and possible regression as sufficient to dismiss a local checker. C5 changes the method contract so a source rule, locale files and an independent check can support a bounded key/placeholder opportunity while translation quality remains residual.

claimBoundary: Development evidence only. C5 proves the candidate/recommendation and malformed-submission contracts through deterministic tests and preserves a bounded passing-task opportunity. It does not establish real model behavior, a new program, natural package consumption, effect improvement, prospective readiness, held-out performance, or human savings.
